Being A Graduated Course Of Analysis For The Use Of Students And All Those Engaged In The Examination Of Metallic Combinations

arxiv-1807-01811.title: Quantum Hall Ground States and Regular Graphs
arxiv-1807-01811.creator: Hamed Pakatchi
arxiv-1807-01811.description: Abstract We show that every uniform state on the sphere is essentially a superposition of regular graphs. In addition, we develop a graph-based ansatz to construct trial FHQ ground states sharing the local properties of Jack polynomials. In particular, our graphic states have the ( k , r ) (k,r) clustering property.

arxiv-2107-14181.title: Infinitesimal reference frames suffice to determine the asymmetry properties of a quantum system
arxiv-2107-14181.creator: Rhea Alexander, Si Gvirtz-Chen, David Jennings
arxiv-2107-14181.description: Abstract Symmetry principles are fundamental in physics, and while they are well understood within Lagrangian mechanics, their impact on quantum channels has a range of open questions. The theory of asymmetry grew out of information-theoretic work on entanglement and quantum reference frames, and allows us to quantify the degree to which a quantum system encodes coordinates of a symmetry group.

arxiv-2202-00483.title: Shearing maps and a Runge map of the unit ball which does not embed into a Loewner chain with range ℂ n \mathbb{C}^{n} Thanks: 1 Partially supported by PRIN 2017 Real and Complex Manifolds: Topology, Geometry and holomorphic dynamics, Ref: 2017JZ2SW5, by GNSAGA of INdAM and by the MIUR Excellence De
arxiv-2202-00483.creator: Filippo Bracci †, Pavel Gumenyuk
arxiv-2202-00483.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Filippo Bracci †, Pavel Gumenyuk. In this paper we study the class of “shearing” holomorphic maps of the unit ball of the form ( z , w ) ↦ ( z + g ⁡ ( w ) , w ) (z,w)\mapsto(z+g(w),w) .

arxiv-2206-00380.title: Strongly Augmented Contrastive Clustering Thanks: This project was supported by the NSFC (61976097, 61876193 & 62076258) and the Natural Science Foundation of Guangdong Province (2021A1515012203). (Corresponding author: Dong Huang) X. Deng, D. Huang, and D.-H. Chen are with the College of Mathematic
arxiv-2206-00380.creator: Xiaozhi Deng, Dong Huang, Ding-Hua Chen
arxiv-2206-00380.description: Abstract Deep clustering has attracted increasing attention in recent years due to its capability of joint representation learning and clustering via deep neural networks. In its latest developments, the contrastive learning has emerged as an effective technique to substantially enhance the deep clustering performance.

arxiv-2207-13015.title: Potentially semi-stable deformation rings for representations with values in PGL n \operatorname{PGL}_{n}
arxiv-2207-13015.creator: Agnès David, Sandra Rozensztajn
arxiv-2207-13015.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Agnès David, Sandra Rozensztajn. We study the potentially semi-stable deformation rings for Galois representations taking their values in PGL n \operatorname{PGL}_{n} , by comparing them to the deformation rings for GL n \operatorname{GL}_{n} . As an application, we state an analogue of the Breuil-Mézard conjecture, and we show that the case of PGL n \operatorname{PGL}_{n} follows from the case of GL n \operatorname{GL}_{n} . 2010 Mathematics Subject Classification 11F80 1.

arxiv-2311-01140.title: The TYPHOON stellar population synthesis survey: I. The young stellar population of the Great Barred Spiral NGC 1365
arxiv-2311-01140.creator: Eva Sextl, Rolf-Peter Kudritzki, Andreas Burkert, I-Ting Ho, H. Jabran Zahid, Mark Seibert, Andrew J. Battisti, Barry F. Madore, Jeffrey A. Rich
arxiv-2311-01140.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Eva Sextl, Rolf-Peter Kudritzki, Andreas Burkert, I-Ting Ho, H. Jabran Zahid, Mark Seibert, Andrew J. Battisti, Barry F. Madore, Jeffrey A. Rich. We analyze TYPHOON long slit absorption line spectra of the starburst barred spiral galaxy NGC 1365 obtained with the Progressive Integral Step Method covering an area of 15 square kpc.

arxiv-2311-02552.title: IPVNet: Learning Implicit Point-Voxel Features for Open-Surface 3D Reconstruction Journal: Journal of Visual Communication and Image Representation
arxiv-2311-02552.creator: Mohammad Samiul Arshad, William J. Beksi
arxiv-2311-02552.description: Abstract Reconstruction of 3D open surfaces (e.g., non-watertight meshes) is an underexplored area of computer vision. Recent learning-based implicit techniques have removed previous barriers by enabling reconstruction in arbitrary resolutions. Yet, such approaches often rely on distinguishing between the inside and outside of a surface in order to extract a zero level set when reconstructing the target.

arxiv-2408-09512.title: Contactless seismocardiography via Gunnar-Farneback optical flow Thanks: *This work was supported by the National Science Foundation under Grant No. 2340020 and a SMART Business Act Grant through Mississippi Institutions of Higher Learning (Grant No. 2024-04). Corresponding author: ataebi@abe.msstat
arxiv-2408-09512.creator: Mohammad Muntasir Rahman, Amirtahà Taebi
arxiv-2408-09512.description: Abstract Seismocardiography (SCG) has gained significant attention due to its potential applications in monitoring cardiac health and diagnosing cardiovascular conditions. Conventional SCG methods rely on accelerometers attached to the chest, which can be uncomfortable or inconvenient. In recent years, researchers have explored non-contact methods to capture SCG signals, and one promising approach involves analyzing video recordings of the chest.

arxiv-2410-18827.title: Investigation of the nature of the wind interaction in HD 93205 based on multi-epoch X-ray observations
arxiv-2410-18827.creator: Bharti Arora, Michaël De Becker
arxiv-2410-18827.description: Abstract Context. The study of the X-ray emission from massive binaries constitutes a relevant approach to investigate shock physics. The case of short period binaries may turn out to be quite challenging, especially in very asymmetric systems where the primary wind may overwhelm that of the secondary in the wind interaction. Aims.

arxiv-2503-20708.title: Fluctuation-dissipation of the Kuramoto model on fruit-fly connectomes
arxiv-2503-20708.creator: Géza Ódor, István Papp, Gustavo Deco
arxiv-2503-20708.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Géza Ódor, István Papp, Gustavo Deco. We investigate the distance from equilibrium using the Kuramoto model via the degree of fluctuation-dissipation violation as the consequence of different levels of edge weight anisotropies. This is achieved by solving the synchronization equations on the raw, homeostatic weighted and a random inhibitory edge variant of a real full fly (FF) connectome, containing ≃ 10 5 \simeq 10^{5} neuron cell nodes. We investigate these systems close to their synchronization transition critical points.

arxiv-2602-14910.title: Position: Introspective Experience from Conversational Environments as a Path to Better Learning
arxiv-2602-14910.creator: Claudiu Cristian Musat, Jackson Tolins, Diego Antognini, Jingling Li, Martin Klissarov, Tom Duerig
arxiv-2602-14910.description: Abstract Current approaches to AI training treat reasoning as an emergent property of scale. We argue instead that robust reasoning emerges from linguistic self-reflection, itself internalized from high-quality social interaction. Drawing on Vygotskian developmental psychology, we advance three core positions centered on Introspection.

pmc-10689608.title: In-silico analysis of potent Mosquirix vaccine adjuvant leads
pmc-10689608.creator: Okello Harrison Onyango, Cynthia Mugo Mwenda, Grace Gitau, John Muoma, Patrick Okoth
pmc-10689608.description: BackgroundWorld Health Organization recommend the use of malaria vaccine, Mosquirix, as a malaria prevention strategy. However, Mosquirix has failed to reduce the global burden of malaria because of its inefficacy. The Mosquirix vaccine’s modest effectiveness against malaria, 36% among kids aged 5 to 17 months who need at least four doses, fails to aid malaria eradication.

pmc-10699775.title: RAD54L2-mediated DNA damage avoidance pathway specifically preserves genome integrity in response to topoisomerase 2 poisons
pmc-10699775.creator: Huimin Zhang, Yun Xiong, Yilun Sun, Jeong-Min Park, Dan Su, Xu Feng, Sarah Keast, Mengfan Tang, Min Huang, Chao Wang, Mrinal Srivastava, Chang Yang, Dandan Zhu, Zhen Chen, Siting Li, Ling Yin, Yves Pommier, Junjie Chen
pmc-10699775.description: Type II topoisomerases (TOP2) form transient TOP2 cleavage complexes (TOP2ccs) during their catalytic cycle to relieve topological stress. TOP2ccs are covalently linked TOP2-DNA intermediates that are reversible but can be trapped by TOP2 poisons. Trapped TOP2ccs block transactions on DNA and generate genotoxic stress, which are the mechanisms of action of TOP2 poisons.

pmc-10771103.title: Does the Number of Interbody Devices Affect the Fusion Outcome in Short-Segment Posterior Lumbar Fusion?
pmc-10771103.creator: Mara Atherton, Aleeza Safdar, Rouzbeh Motiei-Langroudi
pmc-10771103.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Introduction: Interbody devices (IBDs) have been shown to improve outcomes when used in posterior lumbar fusion (PLF) surgery; however,the exact extent of their clinical benefit remains a current topic of interest. Our primary objective in this study was to identify whether the use of an IBD at every level of fusion construct would affect fusion outcomes such as adjacent segment pathology (ASP) and pseudarthrosis after one- to three-level PLF surgery.Methods: This was a single-institution retrospective study.

pmc-11338563.title: An efficient multiscale method for subwavelength transient analysis of acoustic metamaterials
pmc-11338563.creator: R Liupekevicius, J A W van Dommelen, M G D Geers, V G Kouznetsova
pmc-11338563.description: A reduced-order homogenization framework is proposed, providing a macro-scale-enriched continuum model for locally resonant acoustic metamaterials operating in the subwavelength regime, for both time and frequency domain analyses. The homogenized continuum has a non-standard constitutive model, capturing a metamaterial behaviour such as negative effective bulk modulus, negative effective density and Willis coupling.

pmc-11451163.title: Autistic and schizotypal traits exhibit similarities in their impact on mentalization and adult attachment impairments: a cross-sectional study
pmc-11451163.creator: Dániel Sörnyei, Ágota Vass, Dezső Németh, Kinga Farkas
pmc-11451163.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundDeficits in mentalizing and attachment occur in the autism and schizophrenia spectrum, and their extended traits in the general population. Parental attachment and the broader social environment highly influence the development of mentalizing.

pmc-11476582.title: Regulatory Role of IL6 in Immune-Related Adverse Events during Checkpoint Inhibitor Treatment in Melanoma
pmc-11476582.creator: Krishna P. Singh, Anuj Singh, Olaf Wolkenhauer, Shailendra Kumar Gupta
pmc-11476582.description: The landscape of clinical management for metastatic melanoma (MM) and other solid tumors has been modernized by the advent of immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICI), including programmed cell death-1 (PD-1), programmed cell death-ligand 1 (PD-L1), and cytotoxic T lymphocyte antigen 4 (CTLA-4) inhibitors.

pmc-11495022.title: Study on the balance and gait characteristics of subjects with generalized joint hypermobility residing in high-altitude using wearable devices: a cross-sectional study
pmc-11495022.creator: Mingwei Liu, Luqi Guo, Jinpeng Lin, Yuepeng Cai, Xiaofan Huang, Yue Wu, Yu Zhang, Shaobai Wang
pmc-11495022.description: PurposeTo investigate the characteristics of balance and gait functions in Generalized Joint Hypermobility (GJH) subjects residing in high-altitude areas.MethodsThis study included 61 university students (28 with GJH and 33 healthy controls) all from the high-altitude region of Linzhi, Tibet Autonomous Region.

pmc-12610240.title: Targeted Hyaluronan Degradation Enhanced Tumor Growth Inhibition in Gastrointestinal Cancer Models
pmc-12610240.creator: Fulai Zhou, Guangmao Mu, Honglei Bi, Limin Chen, Zhengxia Zha, Ying Jin, Mark L Chiu, Marzia Bruna Gariboldi
pmc-12610240.description: Simple SummaryStronger tumor growth inhibition was demonstrated with targeted disruption of the hyaluronan (HA) barrier that surrounded solid tumor cells. Systemic delivery of hyaluronidase can break down HA but is not effective when used alone and can cause adverse effects.

pmc-12991619.title: Observational Study on the Effectiveness of Ventilator-Assisted Preoxygenation (VAPOX) Over Bag Valve Mask (BVM) Ventilation During Rapid Sequence Intubation in Patients with Acute Respiratory Distress
pmc-12991619.creator: R. J. Ramu, K. V. Anand, Jithin Jacob Varghese, Jithin Suresh, R. G. Remya
pmc-12991619.description: Purpose:To evaluate the effectiveness of Ventilator-Assisted Preoxygenation (VAPOX) compared with Bag Valve Mask (BVM) ventilation during Rapid Sequence Intubation (RSI) in patients presenting with acute respiratory distress.Materials and Methods:This observational study enrolled 60 critically ill patients requiring emergency intubation. Participants aged 40–90 years were consecutively allocated to receive preoxygenation by either VAPOX (n = 30) or BVM (n = 30).

pmc-13022949.title: Exocortex Network for AI-Augmented Human-Led Scientific Expedition
pmc-13022949.creator: Esther H. R. Tsai, Kevin G. Yager
pmc-13022949.description: AI advances in science can be viewed along two main directions with a fluid boundary: enhancing efficiency through automation and smart tools to accelerate tasks that humans can already perform; and enabling exploration into uncharted territories and potentially toward AGI.

pmc-13248598.title: Cortical Lytic Lesion of the Proximal Tibia in an 8-Year-Old Child: A Pediatric Diagnostic Conundrum
pmc-13248598.creator: K Dharmaraj, Kevin Lourdes, Mohan Choudhary, Arjun Ganesh, Raja Sujith Kumar
pmc-13248598.description: Introduction:Non-ossifying fibroma (NOF) is a common benign fibrous lesion seen in children and adolescents and is usually asymptomatic. It is often found incidentally and most commonly involves the metaphyseal region of long bones. However, when the lesion arises from the cortical bone and presents with pain, it may clinically and radiologically mimic osteoid osteoma, leading to diagnostic confusion.

pmc-13573687.title: Association of the glucose-to-lymphocyte ratio with all-cause and cardiovascular disease mortality in U.S. adults: A population-based cohort study
pmc-13573687.creator: Yongtong He, Qiyin Cai, Songbai Wang
pmc-13573687.description: Highlights•Elevated GLR is independently associated with higher all-cause and CVD mortality in a J-shaped manner.•GLR showed comparable or modestly better discrimination than individual inflammatory biomarkers.•The association persisted across sensitivity, competing-risk, and subgroup analyses after multiple-testing correction.•GLR improved risk reclassification when added to a basic Framingham risk model.

pmc-13641526.title: Validation of the Standardized Outcomes in Nephrology–Life Participation Instrument in People with CKD
pmc-13641526.creator: Anastasia Hughes, Cameron Burnett, Angela Ju, Yeoungjee Cho, Armando Teixeira-Pinto, Chandana Guha, Martin Howell, David W. Johnson, Vanessa Kumar, Fergus J. Caskey, Jonathan C. Craig, Meghan J. Elliott, Janine Farragher, Sharlene Greenwood, Adeera Levin, Amanda Sluiter, Hernan Trimarchi, Bill Wang,
pmc-13641526.description: Visual Abstract Introduction People with CKD not yet requiring KRT experience an increased risk of morbidity and high symptom burden, which can profoundly affect their sense of self, independence, and connections with others, affecting their ability to participate in daily activities and their quality of life.
